translations.Arquitectura de procesamiento: IFindIT e: Processing architecture: IFINDIT is based on Kappa architecture because it is necessary to have a data processing architecture designed to provide a scalable, fault-tolerant and flexible system for processing large amounts of data in both real time and batch.
translations.Kappa utiliza un único sistema de proces: Kappa uses a single data processing system to handle processing workloads in both flows and batches; this allows more agile and simple data processing while providing fast and reliable access to query results.
translations.Almacenamiento en formato columnar: Esto: Columnar storage: This means that only loads the columns needed for a specific query, this allows to improve the speed of queries that recover only a few columns and additions (e.g. how many people with what features, in what period of time, etc.).
translations.Sistema distribuido escalable: La plataf: Scalable distributed system: The platform allows to grow elastically, given the high demand for information requested, it is necessary to contemplate operations that may include data loading at a speed of millions of records per minute and at the same time attend queries that generate results in a few seconds.
translations.Procesamiento masivamente paralelo: La p: Massively parallel processing: The platform receives requirements that can include hundreds of millions of data in a single query, so it is necessary for the platform to be able to process each query in parallel throughout the cluster.
translations.Reportes: Permite generar reportes, dato: Reports: Allows to generate reports, aggregated data, columns, counts, SQL-type queries
translations.Creación de consultas o reportes tipo Wi: Creating Wizard-type queries or reports: Allows people who do not have a high technical level to create reports in such a way that it is possible to split the workload to meet requirements quickly.

translations.Datos sin agregar: xls, csv, txt, Json,: Unadded data: xls, csv, txt, Json, XML
translations.Datos en masa: permite extraer datos en: Mass data: allows extracting data in packages of millions of records from dozens of columns each
translations.Visualización: La plataforma está en cap: Visualization: The platform is capable of displaying data with visual features such as control dashboards, both for aggregated and non-aggregated data and capable of being displayed on both desktop and mobile devices
translations.Seguridad: La plataforma provee mecanism: Security: The platform provides role-based authentication and access control mechanisms. It integrates with the Active Directory, but also allows the creation of local users to the platform.
translations.Robustez: IFindIT está en capacidad de s: Robustness: IFINDIT is capable of being used by thousands of users simultaneously, responding to requirements without impacting the information systems where the data are contained, these impacts are evident in particular in Databases, where memory consumption is very high in case of attendance.
translations.IFindIT® maneja datos a través de tres p: IFINDIT® handles data through three basic processes: data extraction, data transformation, data lake loading and data visualization. These processes ensure timely and sufficient information for decision-making in various functional areas of the organization.
translations.IFindIT® Analytics, se especializa en an: IFINDIT® Analytics specializes in data analytics at Big Data level, allowing large volumes of data to be processed with quick responses. It offers a comprehensive solution that includes the infrastructure needed to perform complex calculations in terms of millions of records. With more than 160 connectors, it allows to extract data from various sources, such as commercial databases (JDBC), flat files (csv, tsv), json files, xml and Excel spreadsheets, is a valuable source for data analytics in the different operating areas of the organizations. IFINDIT® Analytics eliminates customer concern for infrastructure and resource management, providing immediate responses to analytical requirements.
translations.El proceso de transformación de datos es: The process of data transformation is crucial to turning information into elements of judgement that can be used to make sound decisions. In IFINDIT Analytics, the transformation takes place using Big Data techniques, allowing large volumes of data to be cleaned in a matter of hours, not days or weeks.
translations.IFindIT Analytics se centra en la limpie: IFINDIT Analytics focuses on data cleaning at this stage, ensuring that they meet the required features and quality required for the specific intended use. With the features of Big Data, the platform allows large amounts of data to be consumed at extraordinary speeds, facilitating immediate calculations for business units.
translations.Los analistas de datos tienen acceso a g: Data analysts have access to gigabytes of information, allowing them to obtain indicators, apply filters and build control dashboards interactively. End users can build their own control dashboards intuitively, without the need for programming knowledge, using functions such as “dragging” and “dropping”. This streamlines the process without relying on the intervention of the IT area to meet its requirements.
translations.Los datos se trabajan según las necesida: The data is worked according to consumption needs, either in real time (streaming) for calculations that require constant update or batch (batch) for results that can be consumed at specific times. In an hour, 180 million records of 90 fields each can be cleaned, demonstrating the efficiency and speed of the process.
translations.III PROCESO DE CARGA EN EL LAGO DE DATOS: III Charging process in the data lake
translations.Después de la transformación de datos, e: After data transformation, these are directed to a lake with the capacity to manage Big Data volumes, allowing different treatments according to the needs of the organization or functional areas. Structured data are used for calculations using a library with approximately 50 interactive dashboards.
translations.IFindIT Analytics facilita la realizació: IFINDIT Analytics facilitates analytical exercises by having both structured data and data extracted from unstructured sources in a columnar database called IFINDIT Columnar. Designed to optimize analysis of large volumes of information, it offers answers in seconds. The tool responds immediately to file search requests, providing access or enabling analytic calculations to be performed at Big Data speed.
translations.La analítica se lleva a cabo mediante Ta: The analytics is carried out using Interactive Control Dashboards, which allow you to build efficient visualizations without the need for programming, through intuitive methods such as “drag and drop”. Users who prefer different display tools can connect to the data lake using an API to take advantage of the benefits of IFINDIT Column.
translations.El módulo de seguridad en la solución IF: The security module in the IFINDIT® solution is essential to ensure controlled access to data. Integrated with the Active Directory, it establishes security levels based on user roles and company policies. Access privileges inherit the policies of the integrated web information system, ensuring security from source.
translations.La arquitectura de seguridad de la herra: The security architecture of the tool is designed to mitigate common attacks, such as code injection and denials of service. The communication between the server and clients can be configured to use only secure protocols (SSL), ensuring data protection during transmission, both in text searches and in the presentation of interactive reports. This safe approach allows for internal and external deployments, providing full data protection.

The Bank wanted to move from a hierarchical scheme to a process scheme, generate knowledge, strengthen its search system, so that more than 5,000 employees would have access to up-to-date and calculated real-time information and carry out advanced exploration of those data, to improve customer care levels and reduce call center call times. SOLUTION They implemented a Search-Based Solution that allows indexing thousands of documents and contents on the Bank's intranet, centralizing information to minimize search times (less than two seconds in response time), generating knowledge from the ease of locating data and information already generated inside the bank. Within the Search Solution, a question module was developed for Megaline Bank's call center, allowing officials to find all information about the bank's service portfolio and meet customers' needs in terms of service and portfolio marketing issues. One of the key parts of this Solution is the Creangel Search-Based Application that uses Google Search Appliance as part of its platform.
